name: SM/CE copy efficiency (nvbandwidth)
description: Ratio (between 0.0 and 1.0) showing compute-core copy efficiency vs. raw DMA Copy Engine capacity, or in other terms, the ratio between CE (Copy Engine) and Streaming Multiprocessor (SM).

environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
environment_fields.gpu_count: Number of GPUs seen by nvbandwidth.
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.cuda_version: Highest CUDA version supported by the CUDA driver library nvbandwidth ran with, as major*1000 + minor*10 (e.g. 12060 = 12.6).
environment_fields.p2p_supported: Whether peer-to-peer (device-to-device) GPU transfers were supported.
environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
